نتناقش (form VI)
# نَتَنَاقَشُ (natanāqašu) /na.ta.naː.qa.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
# نَتَنَاقَشَ (natanāqaša) /na.ta.naː.qa.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
# نَتَنَاقَشْ (natanāqaš) /na.ta.naː.qaʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
